content: ‌ʻE hoku tuofefine mo hoku uaifi, kuo u haʻu ki heʻeku ngoue:

content.text: kuo u tānaki ʻa ʻeku mula, mo ʻeku kakala;
kuo u kai ʻa ʻeku hone pea mo hono ngeʻesi;
kuo u inu ʻi heʻeku uaine mo ʻeku huʻahuhu:
ʻE hoku kāinga,
ke tau kai,
pea inu, ʻio, ke inu lahi ʻakimoutolu ʻoku ou ʻofa ai.
‌ʻOku ou mohe, ka ʻoku ʻā hoku loto:
ko e leʻo ia ʻo hoku ʻofaʻanga, ʻoku ne tukituki,
ʻo ne pehē, “ʻE hoku tuofefine, mo hoku ʻofaʻanga, ko ʻeku lupe,
ko ʻeku haohaoa, toʻo kiate au:
he kuo pito hoku ʻulu ʻi he hahau,
mo hoku louʻulu ʻi he viviku ʻoe poʻuli.
Kuo u toʻo hoku kofutuʻa; pea ʻe fēfē haʻaku toe ʻai ia?
Kuo u fufulu hoku vaʻe, pea ʻe fēfē haʻaku toe ʻuliʻi ia?
Naʻe ʻai mai ʻae nima ʻo hoku ʻofaʻanga ʻi he kātupa,
pea naʻe ngaue hoku loto kiate ia.
Ne u tuʻu hake ke toʻo ki hoku ʻofaʻanga;
pea naʻe toʻi mei hoku nima ʻae mula,
pea mei hoku louhiʻi nima ʻae mula namu lelei,
pea tafe hifo ia ki he toʻoʻanga matapā.
Naʻaku toʻo ki hoku ʻofaʻanga;
ka kuo tafoki atu ʻa hoku ʻofaʻanga, ʻo ne ʻalu:
naʻe vaivai ʻa hoku loto ʻi heʻene lea mai:
ne u kumi kiate ia, ka naʻe ʻikai te u maʻu ia;
ne u ui ki ai, ka naʻe ʻikai te ne tali au.
Pea naʻe ʻiloʻi au ʻe he kau leʻo naʻe feʻaluʻaki ʻi he kolo, ʻonau taaʻi au,
pea u lavea ai;
pea naʻe toʻo ʻa hoku pūlou ʻe he kau leʻohi ʻoe ʻā.
‌ʻE ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Selūsalema, ʻoku ou fekau kiate kimoutolu,
ʻoka mou ka ʻilo ʻa hoku ʻofaʻanga,
ke mou tala ki ai ʻoku ou pongia ʻi he ʻofa.
Ko e hā hono lelei hake ʻo ho ʻofaʻanga ʻi he ʻofaʻanga ʻo ha taha kehe,
ʻa koe ʻoku fungani hoihoifua ʻi he kakai fefine?
ko e hā hono lelei hake ʻo ho ʻofaʻanga ʻi he ʻofaʻanga ʻo ha taha kehe,
koeʻuhi kuo ke fekau pehē ai kiate kimautolu.
‌ʻOku hinehina mo nganongano ʻa hoku ʻofaʻanga,
ko e fungani toulekeleka ia ʻi ha toko mano.
‌ʻOku tatau mo e fungani koula lelei ʻa hono ʻulu,
ʻoku fafatu hono louʻulu, pea ʻuliʻuli ʻo hangē ko e leveni.
‌ʻOku lelei ʻae ʻaiʻanga ʻo hono kanoʻi mata,
pea ʻoku hangē ko e mata ʻoe lupe ʻi he veʻe vaitafe kuo fufulu ʻaki ʻae huʻahuhu.
‌ʻOku tatau hono kouʻahe mo e tokanga ngoue ʻoe ngaahi kakala;
ʻo hangē ko e ngaahi matalaʻi kakala:
ʻoku hangē ko e lile ʻa hono loungutu,
ʻoku toʻi mei ai ʻae mula namu kakala.
‌ʻOku tatau hono nima mo e ngaahi mama koula kuo ʻai ki ai ʻae pelili,
mo hono sino ʻoku hangē ko e lei ngingila kuo ʻaofi ʻaki ʻae safaia.
‌ʻOku tatau hono vaʻe mo e pou maka lelei, kuo fokotuʻu ki he tuʻunga koula:
ʻoku hangē ko Lepanoni ʻa hono fofonga, ʻo tatau mo e ngaahi sita ʻa hono lelei.
‌ʻOku melie lahi hono ngutu:
ʻio, ʻoku toulekeleka kotoa pē ia.
Ko hoku ʻofaʻanga eni,
pea ko hoku kāinga ia,
ʻE ngaahi ʻofefine ʻo Selūsalema.
